_comment: Single source of truth for the desktop-agent update manifest (releases.json). Bump version/notes here, drop the matching artifact into public/downloads, then run make-releases-manifest.mjs (or publish-desktop-release.sh). SHA-256 is computed from the real file — never hand-edited.

windows.notes: Reliable YouTube direct-video playback, contextual numeric retry choices, autostart and verified update downloads.

macos.notes: Current public macOS build. The 2026.6.6/2026.6.7 source is ready for the next CI/Mac build.
